name: FaithInfused Profit Analyzer for WooCommerce
author: Faith Infused

sections.description:
The FaithInfused Profit Analyzer for WooCommerce plugin offers store owners comprehensive financial analysis tools by tracking the following key metrics:

  • Revenue: Easily view and monitor your store’s sales.
  • Expenses: Record costs, such as product costs, shipping, and transaction fees.
  • Profit Margins: Analyze net profits after deducting expenses from revenue.
  • Product Performance: Evaluate profitability for individual products or categories.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Make informed decisions to optimize product pricing, reduce costs, and improve profitability.

usage instructions

  1. Dashboard Access: Once installed, go to the ‘Profit Analyzer’ menu in your WordPress admin dashboard to begin.
  2. Record Expenses: Add the relevant costs (product costs, shipping, fees) to ensure accurate profit calculations.
  3. Analyze Profits: View a breakdown of profits for specific products using the analytics and reports feature.
  4. Backup Recommendation: It’s always a good idea to back up your WooCommerce data regularly before making significant changes.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin: Upload the faithinfused-profit-analyzer-for-woocommerce plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the Dashboard: Navigate to the ‘Profit Analyzer’ section in the WordPress admin menu to start analyzing your store’s profit.
sections.faq:
Q: Does this plugin support variable products?
A: Yes, the plugin supports both simple and variable WooCommerce products.

Q: Can I track expenses outside of WooCommerce transactions?
A: Yes, you can manually add expenses such as advertising costs, shipping fees, and more.

Q: How are profits calculated?
A: Profits are calculated by deducting the recorded expenses from the total sales revenue.

Q: Can I generate product-specific reports?
A: Absolutely. The plugin allows you to create custom reports for individual products or categories.
